item.title: Hope police investigating deadly Sunday shooting
item.description: Police in Hope are investigating a deadly shooting that took place on Sunday.

item.title: Darius Acuff Jr. sets SEC record with 7th Freshman of the Week honor
item.description: Arkansas Razorbacks' Darius Acuff Jr. was named SEC Freshman of the Week for a record 7th time after averaging 29.5 points and six assists in wins against LSU and Auburn.

item.title: Family mourns Beebe man killed in weekend stabbing
item.description: A Beebe family is searching for answers after a 65-year-old man was found dead in his home in what police say was the result of a fatal stabbing.

item.title: Captured Arkansas prison escapee Grant Hardin due in court Tuesday
item.description: Grant Hardin, a former police chief in Gateway, Arkansas, who was serving an 80-year sentence for rape and murder, is due in court Tuesday morning after allegedly escaping the Department of Corrections North Central Unit in Calico Rock in May 2025.

item.title: North Little Rock family business opens back up after months of being closed down after fire
item.description: Cary’s Grill and Bar had been closed for four months after a business next door had a fire that caused smoke and soot to cover the entire inside of the restaurant. The co-owner of Cary’s Grill and Bar was Terrell Sanders, who explained how the fire from another business affected their own.

item.title: Arkansas honors Daisy Gatson Bates Day
item.description: Monday is Daisy Gatson Bates Day, a state holiday honoring the life and legacy of civil rights leader Daisy Bates, who played a pivotal role in the desegregation of Little Rock Central High School in 1957.

item.title: Ashdown High School basketball team manager hits buzzer beater after opponent’s act of sportsmanship
item.description: On senior night, Ashdown boy's basketball team head coach Roy Backus gave team manager Makhi "Man-Man" Lewis the chance to play in the game, and with the help of Smackover's Bricen Askew, Makhi hit a buzzer-beater three to the delight of the student section.

item.title: Family, faith and music help Conway girl through skull removal surgery
item.description: Music can be used as an escape from reality, but for 13-year-old Savannah Bradford, it isn’t an escape, it’s one of the ways she fights her battles.
